content:
10 weeks ago, a 17-year-old girl walked into law school with a dream she had carried for years.
Today, when I look back at these 10 weeks, I realise just how much that little girl had imagined — but never quite imagined how hectic, overwhelming, exhausting, and beautiful the journey would actually be.
The last 10 weeks have been a blur of 9:30 AM classes, endless readings, assignments, presentations, vivas, moot court preparations, research, deadlines, late nights, very little sleep, and countless moments of thinking, “How am I going to get all of this done?” 😭
There have been days when I felt completely lost. Days when I questioned whether I was good enough. Days when the workload felt like too much.
But then, in the middle of all that chaos, I sometimes stop and think:
“Wait. I’m actually here.”
The same girl who once imagined herself arguing a case, reading judgments, preparing arguments and walking into a courtroom is now actually doing those things.
It may not look exactly like the dream I had at 17.
It’s messier. It’s harder. It’s more exhausting.
But somehow, it feels even more real. 10 weeks down. ⚖️ A lifetime of learning to go.
Still overwhelmed. Still learning. Still dreaming.
But now, finally, I'm living the dream I once only talked about. ❤️
